prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls & Interaction Quickstart Guide: Add a new onboarding screen after home intro that interactively demonstrates desktop pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, leading to post-onboarding drop-off.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Photo Quality Pre-Flight Check: Insert a photo verification step during adoption to evaluate lighting and angle quality before pet rendering begins. (why: Support logged 3 tickets regarding custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly, while adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.)
2: [home, redesign] Desktop Pet Render Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with animated rendering progress components and real-time generation feedback. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off, leaving users uncertain if generation is progressing.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Notice: Display an explicit hint on sign-in explaining that logging into an existing account restores previously created pets automatically. (why: The top support theme with 8 emails is users reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Background Processing Notification Trigger: Enable desktop notification options and a safe-to-minimize indicator on the waiting screen so users can use other apps safely during long setup waits. (why: The waiting step takes over 38 minutes on average (mean 2336s), causing users to close or drop off while waiting.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companion Welcome Value Banner: Update the initial story welcome screen copy and add a feature highlight badge emphasizing lightweight background desktop activity. (why: The initial choose_path step loses 23.8% of users immediately at the start of onboarding.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility Health & Troubleshooting Hint: Add a troubleshooting hint on the home intro screen detailing what to do if the desktop pet isn't visible over existing desktop windows. (why: 3 support tickets reported that pets do not show up on the desktop screen or the app fails to open visibly.)
